name: night-shift-review
description: Night Shift: take one Night Watch Showdown finding to one draft candidate (one card, one number), have a separate reviewer decide it on paired seeds and a holdout range, then verify the proof bundle against the source and build hashes. Never edits cards, merges or opens PRs; Fable/Alex decide.

steps.prompt:
Inputs (data, never shell text): finding={{finding}} report={{report}} card={{card}} field={{field}} to={{to}}
1. Check every input before using it: finding must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,200}\.json$ and be a file in this repository; report must match ^[0-9a-f]{12}$; card must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$; field must be exactly attack, health or stars; to must match ^-?[0-9]{1,2}$. If any check fails, report which one and stop without running anything.
2. Run exactly once from the project root, each value as its own single-quoted argument: node scripts/night-review.mjs draft --finding '<finding>' --report '<report>' --card '<card>' --field '<field>' --to '<to>'
3. Report the exit status and the printed lines exactly. Exit status 2 means the finding or proposal was refused; report the reason and stop. On success report the draft directory and the contents of its proposal.json. Edit no file yourself. Do not touch .kiro/specs/duel-card-pipeline/cards/.
